title: Invitation
dateNotPast: Choose today or a future date.

name: Invitation name
error: The operation did not complete. Check your connection and try again.

editor.chooseDesign: Choose a page design. You can change it later.
editor.title: Invitation editor
editor.removePageDescription: This page will be removed. Photos stay in the invitation library. You can undo this change.
editor.retained: Retained photos: {count}. They return to free slots when you change the layout.
editor.rsvpNote: You can explain how guests should confirm attendance here. Automatic response collection is not available yet.
editor.emptyHint: Choose a page type in the panel to start your invitation.
editor.uploadHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
editor.pickHint: Choose a photo for the selected slot.
editor.deletePhotoDescription: This photo will be removed from every page and the library of this invitation. Photos used by other products are retained. This action cannot be undone.
editor.importHint: Add a photo from the same space without uploading it again.
editor.renameHint: The name identifies this invitation and does not change page content.
editor.choosePageType: Choose the purpose of your new page.
editor.chooseLayout: Choose a layout. You can change it later.
editor.themeHint: Choose a coordinated set of colours, typography and decorations for the whole invitation. Your content stays the same.

templates.hint: A template is a starting point. Every page, text and photo can be changed. The theme comes with the template.
templates.applyHint: Edit the sample text and add photos from your library.
templates.replaceHint: This replaces all current pages and the theme. Photos stay in your library. You can undo this change.
